items.reason: The new webhook indexes metadata by app.slug and returns 404 when missing (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:50-53). The registry actually uses googlecalendar as its key (packages/app-store/apps.metadata.generated.ts:98), whereas its slug is google-calendar (packages/app-store/googlecalendar/_metadata.ts:17), so valid Google Calendar credential sync requests fail.

The membership-only check and return before admin authorization exist at packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/createOAuthAppCredential.ts:30-59. However, the base already contains identical logic at packages/app-store/_utils/createOAuthAppCredential.ts:30-59; this PR only relocates the helper and updates its imports, leaving the pre-existing authorization defect unchanged.
